Swap in your JSONL dataset and run 50 steps to confirm field mapping.
Record VRAM, throughput and eval scores before extending training or changing parallelism.
repos.deps: Python + PyTorch/CUDA；多机要配 DeepSpeed/FSDP 与共享存储；数据需转成约定格式。
repos.depsEn: Python + PyTorch/CUDA; multi-node needs DeepSpeed/FSDP and shared storage; data must follow the expected format.
repos.licenseNote: 代码 Apache-2.0；模型权重与数据集另有许可。
repos.licenseNoteEn: Code is Apache-2.0; model weights and datasets carry their own licenses.

repos.name: PEFT
repos.summary: 参数高效微调的标准库：LoRA、IA3、Prefix Tuning 等适配器，接 Transformers 与 Accelerate。
repos.summaryEn: The standard parameter-efficient fine-tuning library: LoRA, IA3, prefix tuning and other adapters, wired into Transformers and Accelerate.
why: 只训练少量参数，显存与存储成本远低于全参微调。
适配器可以按任务切换，同一基座服务多个场景。
与 Transformers、Accelerate、bitsandbytes 兼容，生态成熟。
whyEn: Trains only a small number of parameters, far below full fine-tuning in memory and storage cost.
Adapters can be swapped per task, so one base model serves several use cases.
Compatible with Transformers, Accelerate and bitsandbytes, with a mature ecosystem.
notFor: 需要改变模型知识边界或做大规模继续预训练，单靠适配器不够。
只想要端到端训练脚本与数据配方，应搭配 TRL 或 LLaMA-Factory。
notForEn: Changing the model’s knowledge boundary or doing large-scale continued pretraining is not enough with adapters alone.
If you want end-to-end training scripts and data recipes, pair it with TRL or LLaMA-Factory.
firstRun: 先确认基座结构与目标模块，选 LoRA 的 rank、alpha 与 dropout。
用 PEFT 的官方示例接上 Transformers Trainer，跑通一次小样本训练。
保存 adapter 而不是整模型；上线时确认推理端能加载同一适配器。
firstRunEn: Confirm the base architecture and target modules; choose LoRA rank, alpha and dropout.
Use the official PEFT example with the Transformers Trainer to complete a small-sample run.
Save the adapter rather than the full model; confirm the inference stack can load the same adapter.
repos.deps: Python + PyTorch；显存取决于基座、序列长度与是否 4bit 量化；推理端需支持 PEFT 适配器。
repos.depsEn: Python + PyTorch; VRAM depends on the base model, sequence length and 4-bit quantisation; the inference stack must support PEFT adapters.
repos.licenseNote: 代码 Apache-2.0；基座模型与数据集许可各自独立。
repos.licenseNoteEn: Code is Apache-2.0; base models and datasets carry separate licences.

repos.name: ms-swift
repos.summary: ModelScope 的微调与部署工具链：LLM、多模态模型的 LoRA/全参、DPO/GRPO、推理与评测。
repos.summaryEn: ModelScope’s fine-tuning and deployment stack: LoRA and full-parameter training for LLMs and multimodal models, DPO/GRPO, inference and evaluation.
why: 训练、推理、评测与部署在同一套命令里，少写胶水代码。
对多模态模型与中文数据配方覆盖较多。
支持 LoRA、全参、DPO、GRPO 等常见路线，适合从实验走到服务。
whyEn: Training, inference, evaluation and deployment share one command surface, reducing glue code.
Broad coverage of multimodal models and Chinese data recipes.
Supports LoRA, full-parameter training, DPO and GRPO, useful from experiment through serving.
notFor: 只在 Hugging Face 生态内工作、且不需要 ModelScope 模型时，依赖会更重。
极端自定义的分布式训练仍要回到 DeepSpeed / Megatron 层。
notForEn: If you work only inside the Hugging Face ecosystem and do not need ModelScope models, the dependency footprint is heavier than necessary.
Highly custom distributed training still belongs in DeepSpeed or Megatron layers.
firstRun: 确认目标模型是否在支持列表内，先跑官方最小示例验证环境。
用 LoRA 在小样本上跑通训练与推理，记录数据格式与 chat template。
需要对齐训练时先做 SFT，再加 DPO/GRPO，并保留同一套评测题。
firstRunEn: Confirm the target model is supported and run the official minimal example to validate the environment.
Run LoRA training and inference on a small sample, recording the data format and chat template.
For alignment, start with SFT, then add DPO/GRPO, keeping the same evaluation set.
repos.deps: Python + PyTorch/CUDA；多模态训练显存更高；部分模型与数据需 ModelScope 访问。
repos.depsEn: Python + PyTorch/CUDA; multimodal training needs more VRAM; some models and datasets require ModelScope access.
repos.licenseNote: 代码 Apache-2.0；模型、数据集与 ModelScope 上的分发条款各自独立。
repos.licenseNoteEn: Code is Apache-2.0; models, datasets and distribution terms on ModelScope are separate.

repos.name: TRL
repos.summary: Hugging Face 的强化学习与对齐训练库：SFT、DPO、PPO、GRPO、奖励模型都能接。
repos.summaryEn: Hugging Face's RL and alignment training library: SFT, DPO, PPO, GRPO and reward models.
why: 与 transformers 生态无缝，模型、分词器、数据集直接复用。
对齐算法覆盖全，适合做 RLHF/DPO 实验。
文档与示例多，适合作为对齐训练的基线。
whyEn: Seamless with the transformers ecosystem; reuse models, tokenizers and datasets directly.
Broad alignment coverage, suitable for RLHF/DPO experiments.
Good docs and examples; a solid baseline for alignment training.
notFor: 只做推理或简单微调，直接用 transformers Trainer 更轻。
超大模型多机训练要另配 DeepSpeed/FSDP。
notForEn: For inference or simple fine-tuning, transformers Trainer is lighter.
Very large multi-node training still needs DeepSpeed/FSDP.
firstRun: 从官方示例跑一个小的 SFT 或 DPO 任务，确认依赖版本。
用 1–2 个模型与固定评测集建立基线，再改奖励或数据。
记录显存与吞吐；对齐训练对超参敏感，一次只改一个变量。
firstRunEn: Run a small SFT or DPO example from the official docs and pin dependency versions.
Build a baseline with 1–2 models and a fixed eval set before changing rewards or data.
Record VRAM and throughput; alignment is hyperparameter-sensitive, so change one variable at a time.
repos.deps: Python + PyTorch；对齐训练通常需要奖励模型或偏好数据；大模型要配 DeepSpeed/FSDP。
repos.depsEn: Python + PyTorch; alignment usually needs a reward model or preference data; large models need DeepSpeed/FSDP.
repos.licenseNote: 代码 Apache-2.0；模型、数据集与偏好数据各有许可。
repos.licenseNoteEn: Code is Apache-2.0; models, datasets and preference data carry their own licenses.

repos.name: torchtune
repos.summary: PyTorch 原生的微调配方库：可读的训练循环、FSDP、激活检查点与常用后训练配方。
repos.summaryEn: A PyTorch-native fine-tuning recipe library: readable training loops, FSDP, activation checkpointing and common post-training recipes.
why: 训练循环写得薄，便于读源码和改数据、损失与采样。
原生支持 FSDP 与激活检查点，能从单卡扩到多卡。
配方覆盖 SFT、DPO 与量化感知训练，不依赖第三方训练框架。
whyEn: Thin training loops make it easy to read the source and change data, loss or sampling.
Native FSDP and activation checkpointing scale from one GPU to many.
Recipes cover SFT, DPO and quantisation-aware training without a third-party training framework.
notFor: 想要开箱 WebUI 与大量现成模型模板，LLaMA-Factory 更省事。
非 PyTorch 技术栈或需要 TensorFlow 的团队不适用。
notForEn: For an out-of-the-box WebUI and many ready model templates, LLaMA-Factory is less work.
Not for non-PyTorch stacks or teams that require TensorFlow.
firstRun: 按官方 recipe 选一个与显存匹配的模型规模，先跑单卡 SFT。
确认 tokenizer、chat template 与数据格式一致，再开激活检查点。
扩到多卡前先测单卡吞吐与显存峰值，避免把通信瓶颈当成模型问题。
firstRunEn: Pick an official recipe whose model size fits your VRAM and run single-GPU SFT first.
Confirm tokenizer, chat template and data format line up before enabling activation checkpointing.
Measure single-GPU throughput and peak VRAM before scaling out, so communication bottlenecks are not mistaken for model issues.
repos.deps: Python + PyTorch/CUDA；多卡需 FSDP 环境；显存取决于模型、序列长度与检查点策略。
repos.depsEn: Python + PyTorch/CUDA; multi-GPU needs an FSDP environment; VRAM depends on model, sequence length and checkpointing strategy.
repos.licenseNote: 代码 BSD-3-Clause；模型权重与数据集另有许可。
repos.licenseNoteEn: Code is BSD-3-Clause; model weights and datasets carry their own licences.

repos.name: DeepSpeed
repos.summary: 微软的大模型训练优化库：ZeRO、Offload、混合精度与 MoE 训练，把显存与吞吐压到可用。
repos.summaryEn: Microsoft's large-model training library: ZeRO, offload, mixed precision and MoE training to make VRAM and throughput usable.
why: ZeRO 分片让单机多卡能训更大模型。
与 Hugging Face Trainer 集成，改几行配置就能用。
支持 CPU/NVMe offload，显存不够时有退路。
whyEn: ZeRO sharding lets one multi-GPU node train larger models.
Integrates with Hugging Face Trainer; a few config lines are enough.
CPU/NVMe offload provides a fallback when VRAM is short.
notFor: 小模型单卡微调，用不到这么重的分布式栈。
配置复杂，调错会变慢而不是变快。
notForEn: Small single-GPU fine-tuning does not need this heavy distributed stack.
Configuration is complex; a wrong setting makes it slower, not faster.
firstRun: 先用单机多卡跑 ZeRO-2，记录每卡显存与吞吐。
显存仍不够再开 ZeRO-3 或 offload，比较吞吐损失。
把配置固定成 JSON，和 Axolotl/TRL 的启动命令一起版本化。
firstRunEn: Start with ZeRO-2 on one multi-GPU node; record per-GPU VRAM and throughput.
If VRAM is still short, enable ZeRO-3 or offload and compare the throughput loss.
Freeze the config as JSON and version it alongside Axolotl/TRL launch commands.
repos.deps: Python + PyTorch/CUDA；多机要 InfiniBand/高速网络；offload 需要足够内存或 NVMe。
repos.depsEn: Python + PyTorch/CUDA; multi-node needs InfiniBand/high-speed network; offload needs enough RAM or NVMe.
repos.licenseNote: 代码 Apache-2.0；模型权重与数据集另有许可。
repos.licenseNoteEn: Code is Apache-2.0; model weights and datasets carry their own licenses.

repos.name: TorchTitan
repos.summary: PyTorch 官方的大模型训练配方：张量并行、流水并行、FSDP 与分布式检查点，按 Llama 3 路线给参考实现。
repos.summaryEn: PyTorch's official large-model training recipe: tensor parallelism, pipeline parallelism, FSDP and distributed checkpoints, following the Llama 3 path.
why: 官方维护，和 PyTorch 新特性同步快。
并行组合与检查点写法清楚，适合做规模化基线。
代码结构干净，方便改成自己的模型。
whyEn: Officially maintained and quick to adopt new PyTorch features.
Clear parallelism combinations and checkpoint patterns — a good scaling baseline.
Clean code structure, easy to adapt to your own model.
notFor: 只想微调一个小模型，直接用 Hugging Face Trainer。
不是开箱即用的产品，需要读代码与调参。
notForEn: For small-model fine-tuning, use Hugging Face Trainer.
It is not a turnkey product; expect to read code and tune.
firstRun: 按官方 README 拉起一个单机多卡 Llama 3 配置。
确认张量并行度与 GPU 数匹配，记录 tokens/s。
用分布式检查点保存再恢复一次，验证断点续训。
firstRunEn: Launch an official single-node multi-GPU Llama 3 config.
Match tensor-parallel degree to GPU count and record tokens/s.
Save and restore a distributed checkpoint once to verify resume.
repos.deps: Python + PyTorch nightly/CUDA；多机需要高速互联；大规模训练要配专用存储。
repos.depsEn: Python + PyTorch nightly/CUDA; multi-node needs high-speed interconnect; large runs need dedicated storage.
repos.licenseNote: 代码 BSD-3-Clause；模型权重与数据集另有许可。
repos.licenseNoteEn: Code is BSD-3-Clause; model weights and datasets carry their own licenses.

repos.name: verl
repos.summary: 字节跳动的 RL 训练框架：面向 LLM Agent 与推理任务，支持 PPO/GRPO 与多轮工具调用。
repos.summaryEn: ByteDance's RL training framework for LLM agents and reasoning tasks, with PPO/GRPO and multi-turn tool use.
why: 为 Agentic RL 设计，能把工具调用轨迹纳入训练。
与 vLLM/SGLang 推理后端配合，rollout 吞吐高。
支持多机多卡与异步训练。
whyEn: Designed for Agentic RL; tool-use trajectories can enter training.
Works with vLLM/SGLang inference backends for high rollout throughput.
Supports multi-node, multi-GPU and asynchronous training.
notFor: 只做 SFT，不需要这么重的 RL 栈。
环境与奖励设计仍要自己做，框架不替你定义任务。
notForEn: SFT-only work does not need this heavy RL stack.
You still design the environment and reward; the framework does not define your task.
firstRun: 从示例环境跑一个单步任务，确认 rollout 与 reward 能通。
加一个多轮工具调用任务，记录轨迹长度与失败类型。
先在 1 个节点跑通再扩多机，避免一上来调分布式。
firstRunEn: Run a single-step task from the example environment to verify rollout and reward.
Add a multi-turn tool-use task and record trajectory length and failure types.
Get one node working before scaling multi-node; do not debug distributed first.
repos.deps: Python + PyTorch/CUDA；rollout 需要 vLLM/SGLang；多机要 Ray 或 Slurm。
repos.depsEn: Python + PyTorch/CUDA; rollout needs vLLM/SGLang; multi-node needs Ray or Slurm.
repos.licenseNote: 代码 Apache-2.0；模型、环境与数据各有许可。
repos.licenseNoteEn: Code is Apache-2.0; models, environments and data carry their own licenses.

repos.name: OpenRLHF
repos.summary: 基于 Ray + vLLM 的 RLHF 训练框架：PPO、GRPO、DPO、KTO 与多机多卡编排。
repos.summaryEn: A Ray + vLLM RLHF framework: PPO, GRPO, DPO, KTO and multi-node orchestration.
why: 把推理、奖励、训练分成可扩展的 Ray actor。
支持 vLLM 加速 rollout，适合大规模对齐。
配置化程度高，社区案例多。
whyEn: Splits inference, reward and training into scalable Ray actors.
vLLM-accelerated rollout for large-scale alignment.
Highly configurable with many community examples.
notFor: 单卡小实验，直接用 TRL 更简单。
需要 Ray 集群经验，调试门槛不低。
notForEn: For small single-GPU experiments, TRL is simpler.
Requires Ray cluster experience; debugging is not trivial.
firstRun: 按官方脚本跑一个单机 PPO 小实验，确认 Ray 与 vLLM 版本。
记录 rollout 与训练的 GPU 分配，避免两边抢显存。
用固定偏好数据对比 DPO 与 PPO 的评测差异。
firstRunEn: Run the official single-node PPO example and pin Ray and vLLM versions.
Record GPU allocation between rollout and training so they do not fight for VRAM.
Compare DPO and PPO on fixed preference data with the same eval set.
repos.deps: Python + PyTorch/CUDA + Ray；rollout 需要 vLLM；多机要共享存储与高速网络。
repos.depsEn: Python + PyTorch/CUDA + Ray; rollout needs vLLM; multi-node needs shared storage and high-speed network.
repos.licenseNote: 代码 Apache-2.0；模型、偏好数据与奖励模型各有许可。
repos.licenseNoteEn: Code is Apache-2.0; models, preference data and reward models carry their own licenses.

repos.name: KTransformers
repos.summary: 面向异构硬件的推理/微调框架：把 MoE 专家卸载到 CPU/内存，用少量 GPU 跑大模型。
repos.summaryEn: Heterogeneous-hardware inference and fine-tuning: offload MoE experts to CPU/RAM so a small GPU can run large models.
why: MoE 模型不必全部塞进显存，适合本地大模型。
支持 Intel/AMD CPU 与特定 GPU 组合。
提供微调与推理两条线。
whyEn: MoE models do not need to fit entirely in VRAM — useful for local large models.
Supports Intel/AMD CPUs with selected GPU combinations.
Covers both fine-tuning and inference.
notFor: 追求通用、稳定的生产推理，优先 vLLM/SGLang。
硬件组合有限制，不是所有模型都支持。
notForEn: For general, stable production inference, prefer vLLM/SGLang.
Hardware combinations are constrained; not every model is supported.
firstRun: 确认 CPU 指令集、内存容量与 GPU 型号在支持列表里。
先用官方脚本跑一个小 MoE 模型，记录显存与内存占用。
再换目标模型，观察专家命中率与 tokens/s 是否符合预期。
firstRunEn: Confirm CPU instruction set, RAM size and GPU model are on the supported list.
Run a small MoE model with the official script; record VRAM and RAM use.
Switch to the target model and check expert hit rate and tokens/s.
repos.deps: Python + PyTorch；需要足够系统内存；部分内核依赖特定 CPU/GPU。
repos.depsEn: Python + PyTorch; needs enough system RAM; some kernels require specific CPUs/GPUs.
repos.licenseNote: 代码 Apache-2.0；模型权重与数据集另有许可。
repos.licenseNoteEn: Code is Apache-2.0; model weights and datasets carry their own licenses.

repos.name: Megatron-LM
repos.summary: NVIDIA 的大规模 Transformer 训练框架，支持张量/流水/序列/上下文并行、FP8、MoE 和分布式 checkpoint。
why: 想理解千卡级训练怎么切模型和激活，Megatron 是事实标准，很多大模型训练栈基于它改。
并行组合、通信重叠和 FP8 训练的实现细节，在论文之外看代码更清楚。
适合做大规模预训练/继续训练的工程基线，而不是只读综述。
notFor: 单卡或小集群微调；配置和并行调优门槛高，小团队用 torchtune/DeepSpeed 更轻。
没有多卡 NCCL 环境，或不愿读分布式 checkpoint 文档的团队。
firstRun: 按 README 安装 PyTorch、CUDA、NCCL 与依赖。
用官方小配置在 2–8 卡上跑通一次 pretrain 迭代。
换张量/流水并行度，记录吞吐、显存与通信开销。
repos.deps: CUDA；PyTorch；NCCL；多 GPU；大规模需要高速互联。
repos.licenseNote: 代码 BSD-3-Clause（NVIDIA 版权）；模型与数据另计。
repos.summaryEn: NVIDIA’s large-scale Transformer training framework with tensor, pipeline, sequence and context parallelism, FP8, MoE and distributed checkpointing.
whyEn: Designed for multi-node large-model training.
Parallelism strategies are configurable rather than ad hoc.
FP8, MoE and distributed checkpoints are supported.
notForEn: You want to fine-tune a 7B model on one GPU.
You do not have a multi-GPU cluster and a training team.
firstRunEn: Run a small single-node example first.
Record the parallelism layout, global batch size and throughput.
Scale to two nodes and check checkpoint resume.

repos.name: LiteLLM
repos.summary: 把 100+ 模型 API 统一成 OpenAI 兼容格式的网关与 SDK：Rust 核心、虚拟密钥、成本追踪、限流/负载均衡、guardrails、日志与缓存，可自托管。
why: 换模型只改 model 名，不用重写调用层；多上游路由与 fallback 在一处配。
团队用虚拟 key 做配额与成本归集，比每人一把上游 key 更可审计。
Rust 核心 + Python SDK，适合做内部 AI 网关，也能直接嵌进应用。
notFor: 它不是推理引擎；本地模型仍要 vLLM、Ollama 等后端。
代理层能看到 prompt 与密钥，必须自己做网络、日志脱敏与权限隔离。
企业目录另有许可，不能把整仓当成纯 MIT 使用。
firstRun: 用官方 Docker 镜像或 pip install "litellm[proxy]" 起服务，先接一个 OpenAI 兼容上游。
在 config.yaml 配 model_list、virtual key 与预算，用一个 SDK 请求验证路由。
再打开 spend tracking 与日志，确认 prompt 不会落到不该去的地方。
repos.deps: Python 3.9+ / Docker；至少一个上游模型 API 或本地推理后端；生产要 Redis/Postgres（配额、缓存、日志）与反向代理。
repos.licenseNote: 代码为 MIT + 企业目录单独许可；企业功能、第三方模型与数据各自条款，商用前读 LICENSE 与 enterprise/LICENSE。
repos.summaryEn: A gateway and SDK that normalises 100+ model APIs into an OpenAI-compatible format, with a Rust core, virtual keys, cost tracking, rate limits, load balancing, guardrails, logging and caching, self-hostable.
whyEn: One API shape across providers.
Virtual keys, budgets and rate limits centralise control.
Self-hosting keeps logs and keys in your infrastructure.
notForEn: You use one provider and one key with no routing needs.
You cannot operate a gateway service.
The enterprise catalogue has separate licensing; do not treat the whole repository as pure MIT.
firstRunEn: Route two providers through one virtual key.
Set a budget and a rate limit, then test both.
Check that logs redact prompts and keys as expected.

repos.name: Google ADK
repos.summary: Google 的代码优先 Python agent 工具包：把工具、会话、记忆、评测与部署放进同一套抽象，可用 Gemini 或其它模型。
why: 官方维护，文档与样例完整，适合从单 agent 走到多 agent 编排。
工具体系与 Google 生态（Vertex AI、Gemini）衔接紧，鉴权与部署路径清楚。
同一套代码可本地跑、可上 Cloud Run，原型到上线的落差小。
notFor: 不是低代码拖拽平台，要写 Python。
部分托管与评测能力绑定 Google Cloud，换云要自己接。
框架抽象较完整，深度定制前先读源码，别把黑盒当标准。
firstRun: pip install google-adk，按 quickstart 建一个带单个 tool 的 agent。
用 adk web 本地跑一轮，观察 tool call、session 与事件流。
再把 agent 拆成 sub-agents，确认路由、状态与错误处理。
repos.deps: Python 3.10+；Gemini API key 或其它模型接入；部署到 Cloud Run 需要 GCP 配置。
repos.licenseNote: Apache-2.0；示例数据、第三方工具与 Google 托管服务各自条款。
repos.summaryEn: Google’s code-first Python agent toolkit, bringing tools, sessions, memory, evaluation and deployment into one abstraction, usable with Gemini or other models.
whyEn: Sessions, memory and evaluation are part of the toolkit.
Works with Gemini and other providers.
Code-first rather than a visual builder.
notForEn: You need a non-Python runtime.
You want a fully hosted agent platform with no deployment work.
The framework has fairly complete abstractions; read the source before deep customisation and do not treat the black box as the standard.
firstRunEn: Run the official sample with one tool.
Add a session and test a multi-turn task.
Run the built-in evaluation on three cases.

repos.name: Letta
repos.summary: 有状态 agent 平台：把记忆分成 core / recall / archival 三层，连同对话、工具调用与 agent 状态一起持久化，跨会话保留并允许 agent 自己编辑记忆。
why: 解决无状态 chat 的遗忘问题；记忆不是简单向量库，而是可读写的分层结构。
提供 REST server 与 Python/TS SDK，方便接自有前端或 IM。
sleep-time agent 与记忆整理把“何时记、记什么”变成可配置流程。
notFor: 记忆越多不等于越准，错误记忆会被反复放大，需要清理与审计。
自托管要管 Postgres/pgvector、嵌入与模型成本。
不是通用工作流引擎，复杂业务编排仍要外接。
firstRun: 用 Docker 起 Letta server，接一个模型；创建一个 agent 并给它一个工具。
连续两轮对话后检查 memory blocks 是否按预期更新。
再试 archival memory 或 sleep-time agent，观察召回与整理结果。
repos.deps: Docker / Python；Postgres + pgvector；LLM API 或本地模型；嵌入模型。
repos.licenseNote: Apache-2.0；模型、嵌入服务与记忆数据另计。
repos.summaryEn: A stateful agent platform that splits memory into core, recall and archival tiers, persisting conversations, tool calls and agent state across sessions and allowing the agent to edit its own memory.
whyEn: Memory tiers are explicit and inspectable.
State persists beyond a single context window.
The agent can edit its own memory, which enables long-running work.
notForEn: You need a stateless request-response service.
You cannot govern what the agent writes into memory.
Not a general workflow engine; complex business orchestration still needs an external layer.
firstRunEn: Create an agent and have a two-session conversation.
Inspect core, recall and archival memory after each turn.
Test a correction and a deletion before trusting it with real data.

repos.name: Open Interpreter
repos.summary: 让模型在本机写并执行代码的终端 agent：把自然语言任务拆成 shell/Python 步骤，读文件、跑命令、看输出再修正；2026 版本转向 Kimi K3.1、GLM 5.3 等开放权重模型。
why: 本地文件与命令直接可操作，适合一次性脚本、数据清理与机器巡检。
可换开放模型，减少对单一 API 的依赖。
终端交互简单，能把“模型会写代码”变成可观察的执行轨迹。
notFor: 默认拥有本机执行权限，误删/越权风险高；生产必须容器化与只读挂载。
它不是沙箱产品，安全边界要自己搭。
复杂任务仍会写出不可维护的脚本，需要人审 diff。
firstRun: 在容器或一次性 VM 里 pip install open-interpreter，接一个模型。
先让它只读列目录、统计 CSV，再给一个临时目录写权限。
检查每一步命令与 diff，别直接对 home 目录或生产仓库跑。
repos.deps: Python 3.10+；模型 API 或本地 OpenAI 兼容端点；Docker/VM 做隔离。
repos.licenseNote: Apache-2.0；模型权重、执行环境与第三方工具另计。
repos.summaryEn: A terminal agent that writes and runs code on your machine: it turns natural-language tasks into shell or Python steps, reads files, runs commands, inspects output and corrects itself; the 2026 version moves toward open-weight models such as Kimi K3.1 and GLM 5.3.
whyEn: Runs real code instead of only describing steps.
Reads local files and observes command output.
Supports open-weight models in the 2026 line.
notForEn: You cannot run generated code in a sandbox.
You need deterministic, auditable workflows.
Complex tasks still produce unmaintainable scripts; a human must review the diff.
firstRunEn: Run it in a disposable container with no credentials.
Ask for a read-only file inspection first.
Add a command allowlist and a hard timeout before write operations.

repos.name: SWE-agent
repos.summary: 把 GitHub issue 变成代码修改的软件工程 agent：通过 agent-computer interface（ACI）把搜索、编辑、测试等命令收进受限接口，让模型闭环修 issue。
why: ACI 设计是核心贡献，比裸 shell 更可控，也更容易复现实验。
NeurIPS 2024 论文与 SWE-bench 评测配套，适合做研究基线。
trajectory 与 patch 可保存，失败能逐 step 复盘。
notFor: 真实仓库仍会失败，不能替代 CI 与人工 review。
给仓库写权限前要隔离密钥与网络。
评测分数受模型、重试预算与 scaffold 影响，不能直接当产品排名。
firstRun: 按 README 用 Docker 起环境，选一个 SWE-bench Lite 实例。
跑一个 issue，保存 trajectory 与 patch。
用官方 harness 评一次通过率，再改 ACI 或模型做对照。
repos.deps: Docker；Python；模型 API；SWE-bench 数据集与评测 harness。
repos.licenseNote: MIT；数据集、仓库代码与模型权重各自许可。
repos.summaryEn: A software-engineering agent that turns a GitHub issue into a code change, using an agent-computer interface (ACI) to constrain search, edit and test commands so the model can close the loop on the issue.
whyEn: The ACI constrains actions instead of giving a raw shell.
Designed around issue-to-patch tasks.
Works with SWE-bench-style evaluation.
notForEn: You need a general chat agent.
You cannot run tests in an isolated repository.
Scores depend on the model, retry budget and scaffold; do not read them as a product ranking.
firstRunEn: Run one issue in a disposable repo with a test command.
Inspect every ACI action and the final patch.
Check whether the patch passes the repository’s tests.

repos.name: Continue
repos.summary: 开源 IDE/CLI 编程 agent：VS Code、JetBrains 插件加 CLI，支持本地或云端模型、规则文件、代码索引与自定义工具。
why: 在编辑器里直接改代码，支持本地模型与隐私模式，适合不能把代码上云的场景。
rules 与模型路由可版本化，团队能共享项目约定。
插件与 CLI 共用配置，终端和 IDE 的体验一致。
notFor: 不是 CI/CD 或代码托管平台；复杂重构仍要人看。
插件与模型组合多，版本兼容要逐个试。
索引大仓库吃内存与磁盘，首次体验不一定顺。
firstRun: 在 VS Code 装 Continue，选一个模型 provider。
建 .continue/rules 写项目约定，索引一个小仓库。
让 agent 改一个测试文件并跑测试，确认 diff 与命令都可见。
repos.deps: VS Code / JetBrains 或 Node CLI；模型 API 或本地 Ollama/vLLM；代码索引占磁盘。
repos.licenseNote: Apache-2.0；模型、扩展市场与第三方插件各自条款。
repos.summaryEn: An open-source IDE and CLI coding agent: VS Code and JetBrains plugins plus a CLI, with local or hosted models, rules files, code indexing and custom tools.
whyEn: Works across VS Code and JetBrains.
Rules files make project conventions explicit.
Local or hosted models can be mixed.
notForEn: You need a fully autonomous long-running agent.
You cannot install IDE plugins or index code.
Indexing large repositories consumes RAM and disk; the first experience may not be smooth.
firstRunEn: Install the plugin and run a read-only explanation task.
Add a rules file and test a style-sensitive edit.
Check what code is indexed before enabling a hosted model.

repos.name: AnythingLLM
repos.summary: 本地优先的 RAG 桌面与服务器：把文档、网页、代码灌进 workspace，接本地或云端模型，提供 chat、agent 与 API。
why: 桌面版开箱即用，适合个人与小团队把资料留在本机。
支持多 workspace、向量库与模型 provider 切换，也能 Docker 自托管。
内置文档解析、引用与 agent 工具，省掉从零搭 RAG 的管线。
notFor: 不是大规模多租户知识平台，权限与审计比企业产品薄。
解析质量决定回答质量，PDF/表格要先检查 chunk。
本地模型效果取决于机器与量化，别拿小模型直接对标云端。
firstRun: 桌面版建一个 workspace，灌 3-5 份小文档。
选嵌入与 LLM provider，问一个能引用原文的问题。
检查 citation 与 chunk，再换向量库或模型对比。
repos.deps: 桌面版或 Docker；嵌入模型 + LLM（本地 Ollama 或 API）；向量库（内置 LanceDB 等）。
repos.licenseNote: MIT；模型、嵌入服务与上传文档的版权另计。
repos.summaryEn: A local-first RAG desktop and server that ingests documents, web pages and code into workspaces, connects local or hosted models and exposes chat, agent and API modes.
whyEn: Desktop and server modes cover personal and team use.
Workspaces keep separate corpora.
Chat, agent and API surfaces share one backend.
notForEn: You need a code-only RAG library.
You cannot manage local data storage and model keys.
Local model quality depends on the machine and quantisation; do not compare a small local model directly with a cloud model.
firstRunEn: Create a workspace with five documents.
Ask a cited question and check the sources.
Try the API mode with the same workspace.

repos.name: Kokoro
repos.summary: 82M 参数的开源 TTS 推理库：轻量、快，Apache 权重，提供多语言 voicepack 与 pip 包，适合本地与边缘部署。
why: 模型小，CPU 也能跑，成本远低于大 TTS。
同尺寸里音质强，适合原型、旁白与低延迟场景。
权重 Apache-2.0，部署限制少。
notFor: 不是声音克隆或情感控制平台；音色与语言受 voicepack 限制。
长文本、多人对话与商业配音仍要工程封装。
仓库最近推送停在 2025-08，权重大版本少，别期待持续新特性。
firstRun: pip install kokoro soundfile，按 README 用 KPipeline 生成一段英文。
换 lang_code 与 voice 试中文/日文，检查发音。
用 1k 字长文测延迟与内存，再决定 CPU 还是 GPU 部署。
repos.deps: Python；PyTorch；espeak-ng（部分语言）；模型权重约几百 MB。
repos.licenseNote: 代码与权重 Apache-2.0；voicepack 与训练数据另核。
repos.summaryEn: An 82M-parameter open TTS inference library: lightweight and fast, with Apache-licensed weights, multilingual voice packs and a pip package for local or edge deployment.
whyEn: Very small and fast.
Apache-licensed weights.
Pip-installable for local and edge use.
notForEn: You need studio-grade expressive control.
You need many languages beyond the released voice packs.
The repository’s last push was 2025-08 and major weight releases are rare; do not expect a stream of new features.
firstRunEn: Install the pip package and synthesise one sentence.
Try two voice packs and compare.
Measure latency on the target edge device.

repos.name: F5-TTS
repos.summary: 基于 Flow Matching 与 Diffusion Transformer 的 TTS：用短参考音频做零样本声音克隆，支持中英与速度控制，提供训练与推理代码。
why: 克隆相似度与自然度在开源 TTS 里靠前，推理代码完整。
可自己微调，适合做有声内容与角色音色。
Sway Sampling 等推理技巧有论文与消融，便于复现。
notFor: 声音克隆涉及声音权与诈骗风险，必须取得授权并披露。
不是实时低延迟引擎，长文本要分块。
参考音频的噪声与口音会直接进入输出。
firstRun: 按 README 装环境与模型，准备 5-10 秒干净参考音频。
用 CLI 生成一句，检查发音与相似度。
再跑 Gradio demo，试中英混排与语速。
repos.deps: Python + PyTorch；GPU 推荐（推理可 CPU 但慢）；参考音频；模型权重。
repos.licenseNote: 代码 MIT；预训练权重与 Emilia 数据可能另有非商用/署名条款，商用前读模型卡。
repos.summaryEn: A TTS model based on Flow Matching and a Diffusion Transformer: zero-shot voice cloning from a short reference, Chinese and English, with speed control and training code.
whyEn: Zero-shot cloning from a short reference.
Flow-matching and DiT architecture.
Training and inference code are available.
notForEn: You need a CPU-only real-time engine.
You cannot secure consent for cloned voices.
Noise and accent in the reference audio pass straight into the output.
firstRunEn: Clone a consented reference and synthesise one sentence.
Test Chinese and English with the same voice.
Compare speed settings for naturalness.

repos.name: TRELLIS
repos.summary: 微软的 3D 资产生成模型：文本或图片输入，输出辐射场、3D Gaussian 与 mesh；核心是 Structured LATent（SLAT）统一表示与 Rectified Flow Transformer。
why: 一个模型支持多种 3D 输出格式，还能做局部编辑，比只出 mesh 的方案灵活。
CVPR 2025 Spotlight，代码与权重开放。
SLAT 表示把几何与外观解耦，便于下游导出与再渲染。
notFor: 生成的是资产草模，拓扑、UV 与材质仍需美术修。
显存与时间门槛高，不是实时工具。
复杂场景与透明材质仍容易失败。
firstRun: 按 README 用 conda 建环境，下载预训练权重。
先用一张物体图跑 image-to-3D，导出 mesh 与 Gaussian。
再试 text-to-3D 与局部编辑，检查面数与纹理。
repos.deps: Linux + NVIDIA GPU（CUDA）；conda；数 GB 权重；Blender/trimesh 查看输出。
repos.licenseNote: 代码 MIT；预训练权重与训练数据条款另核，商用前读模型卡。
repos.summaryEn: Microsoft’s 3D asset generation model: text or image input to a radiance field, 3D Gaussians and a mesh, built on a Structured LATent (SLAT) representation and a Rectified Flow Transformer.
whyEn: One representation supports several 3D outputs.
Open code and weights.
A strong research baseline for image-to-3D.
notForEn: You need production-ready asset pipelines with retopology.
You need CPU-only inference.
Complex scenes and transparent materials still fail often.
firstRunEn: Run the official image-to-3D example.
Export the mesh and inspect scale and normals.
Compare Gaussian and mesh outputs for your use case.

repos.name: kohya_ss
repos.summary: Stable Diffusion 系模型的训练 GUI 与脚本集合：LoRA、DreamBooth、fine-tune、数据集打标与工具，覆盖 SD1/SDXL/FLUX 等。
why: GUI 把复杂训练参数摊开，适合个人与小队做角色/风格 LoRA。
脚本成熟，社区教程多，能和 ComfyUI 工作流衔接。
支持多种基础模型与训练方式，迁移成本低。
notFor: 不是一键出图产品；数据清洗、打标与参数调试决定结果。
训练吃显存与时间，云 GPU 成本要算。
GUI 封装会隐藏细节，出问题仍要读日志与脚本。
firstRun: 按 README 装 venv 与依赖，启动 gui.py。
准备 20-50 张同主体图，用 WD14 打标。
先跑一个低步数 LoRA，固定 seed 对比基模，确认过拟合前停。
repos.deps: Python + PyTorch/CUDA；NVIDIA GPU（8GB 起，越大越稳）；训练图片与正则图；可选 wandb/tensorboard。
repos.licenseNote: Apache-2.0；基础模型、数据集与生成内容各自许可。
repos.summaryEn: A training GUI and script collection for Stable Diffusion models: LoRA, DreamBooth, fine-tuning, dataset tagging and utilities across SD1, SDXL and FLUX.
whyEn: Covers several fine-tuning methods in one toolkit.
Dataset tagging utilities reduce manual work.
Supports SD1, SDXL and FLUX lines.
notForEn: You need a hosted training service.
You cannot curate and license a training dataset.
The GUI hides details; when something breaks you still need the logs and scripts.
firstRunEn: Train a small LoRA on 10 licensed images.
Compare the same seed before and after training.
Check overfitting on a held-out prompt.

repos.name: SWE-bench
repos.summary: 软件工程 agent 的基准与评测 harness：从真实 GitHub issue 与对应 PR 构造任务，测模型能否生成通过测试的 patch。
why: 任务来自真实仓库与测试，比合成题更接近工程。
提供 Docker 评测环境与失败日志，适合做 agent 回归。
Lite / Verified 等子集让成本与难度可选。
notFor: 不是产品榜单；分数受 scaffold、重试预算与模型版本影响。
测试通过不等于代码可维护。
仓库镜像与评测环境占磁盘，首次跑成本不低。
firstRun: 装 SWE-bench harness，拉一个 Lite 实例。
用官方 Docker 环境跑模型 patch，记录 resolved/unresolved。
看失败日志，区分定位错、改错与测试环境问题。
repos.deps: Docker；Python；模型 API 或本地模型；数据集与仓库镜像，磁盘占用大。
repos.licenseNote: MIT；仓库代码、issue/PR 文本与测试数据各自许可。
repos.summaryEn: A software-engineering benchmark and evaluation harness built from real GitHub issues and their pull requests, testing whether a model can produce a patch that passes the tests.
whyEn: Tasks come from real repositories and issues.
Passing tests is the success criterion, not a judge model.
A standard baseline for coding agents.
notForEn: You need a quick smoke test for a chat model.
You cannot run repository test suites in isolation.
Repository mirrors and evaluation environments take disk; the first run is not cheap.
firstRunEn: Run one repository’s test suite on the base commit.
Evaluate one agent patch and inspect the failure logs.
Record the harness version, test command and environment.

repos.name: LitGPT
repos.summary: Lightning AI 的轻量 LLM 训练、微调与部署配方：20+ 模型，支持 pretrain、SFT、LoRA、量化与推理，强调单卡可跑与可读代码。
why: 把训练脚本拆成可读配方，适合学习与中小规模微调。
支持多种模型与 LoRA/量化，不必上重型框架。
单卡就能跑通，实验迭代快。
notFor: 不是大规模分布式训练平台；千卡级训练仍用 Megatron/DeepSpeed。
部分新模型支持滞后，需看版本。
配方多，参数与数据格式要按模型逐项核对。
firstRun: pip install litgpt；下载一个小模型（如 Llama 3.2 1B 或 Gemma）。
跑一次 chat 推理，再用公开小数据集做 LoRA。
导出合并权重，测困惑度与显存。
repos.deps: Python + PyTorch；单卡 GPU 起；模型权重；训练数据。
repos.licenseNote: Apache-2.0；模型权重与数据集另计。
repos.summaryEn: Lightning AI’s lightweight recipes for LLM training, fine-tuning and deployment: 20+ models, pretraining, SFT, LoRA, quantisation and inference, with an emphasis on single-GPU runs and readable code.
whyEn: Recipes are readable and modifiable.
Covers pretraining, SFT, LoRA and quantisation.
Designed to run on a single GPU where possible.
notForEn: You need a large-scale multi-node training framework.
You want a no-code fine-tuning product.
Many recipes; check parameters and data formats model by model.
firstRunEn: Run the smallest SFT recipe on one GPU.
Record memory, throughput and evaluation scores.
Try LoRA and compare quality with full fine-tuning.

repos.name: Transformers
repos.summary: Hugging Face 的模型库与统一接口：AutoModel / AutoTokenizer 覆盖文本、视觉、音频与多模态，支持 PyTorch、TensorFlow、Flax；能直接加载 Hub 权重，也能接 PEFT、vLLM、TGI 等后端。
repos.summaryEn: Hugging Face’s model library and unified interface: AutoModel / AutoTokenizer cover text, vision, audio and multimodal models across PyTorch, TensorFlow and Flax; load Hub weights directly or hand them to PEFT, vLLM or TGI.
why: 模型兼容面最广，换 checkpoint 通常不用重写调用层。
训练与推理接口统一，文档和社区答案最多。
和 datasets、accelerate、peft 配套，适合当基线。
whyEn: The broadest model compatibility layer; switching checkpoints rarely requires rewriting the call site.
Unified training and inference interfaces with the largest documentation and community base.
Pairs with datasets, accelerate and peft, making it a sensible baseline.
notFor: 不是推理服务器；高吞吐部署仍要 vLLM、SGLang 或 TGI。
大模型默认加载会吃显存，需要 device_map、量化或分片。
版本升级偶尔改 API，生产要锁版本。
notForEn: Not an inference server; high-throughput serving still needs vLLM, SGLang or TGI.
Large models load into VRAM by default; use device_map, quantization or sharding.
Occasional API changes between versions — pin versions in production.
firstRun: pip install transformers torch，先加载一个几亿参数的小模型和 tokenizer。
用 pipeline 跑一次文本分类或生成，确认权重、分词与设备都正常。
再接 accelerate 或 peft；部署前换 vLLM/TGI 压测。
firstRunEn: pip install transformers torch, then load a small few-hundred-million-parameter model and tokenizer.
Run one pipeline for classification or generation to confirm weights, tokenizer and device.
Then add accelerate or peft; benchmark vLLM/TGI before deployment.
repos.deps: Python 3.9+ / PyTorch 或 TensorFlow；从 Hugging Face Hub 拉权重需要网络与磁盘；GPU 可选，大模型需要足够显存或分片。
repos.depsEn: Python 3.9+ with PyTorch or TensorFlow; network and disk for Hub weights; GPU optional, but large models need VRAM or sharding.
repos.licenseNote: 代码 Apache-2.0；每个模型权重有自己的许可，商用前逐一读 model card 与 LICENSE。
repos.licenseNoteEn: Code is Apache-2.0; every model weight carries its own licence — read the model card and LICENSE before commercial use.

repos.name: Accelerate
repos.summary: 把 PyTorch 的多 GPU、TPU、混合精度、梯度累积、FSDP 与 DeepSpeed 启动样板收进一个 API：设备放置、分布式启动和混合精度不用手写。
repos.summaryEn: Pulls PyTorch’s multi-GPU, TPU, mixed-precision, gradient-accumulation, FSDP and DeepSpeed boilerplate into one API: device placement, distributed launch and AMP without hand-written scaffolding.
why: 单卡训练脚本加一行 launch 就能跑多卡。
和 Transformers Trainer 解耦，自定义训练循环也能用。
FSDP / DeepSpeed 配置集中，少写分布式样板。
whyEn: A single-GPU script can launch multi-GPU with one command.
Works with custom training loops, not only the Transformers Trainer.
Centralizes FSDP / DeepSpeed configuration and removes distributed boilerplate.
notFor: 不是完整训练框架；数据加载、实验管理和评测仍要自己搭。
多机通信依赖 NCCL 与网络，配置错误排查成本高。
极端大规模仍要专门的分片与容错方案。
notForEn: Not a complete training framework; data loading, experiment tracking and evaluation are still yours.
Multi-node communication depends on NCCL and networking; misconfiguration is expensive to debug.
Extreme scale still needs dedicated sharding and fault tolerance.
firstRun: pip install accelerate，运行 accelerate config 生成默认配置。
用 accelerate launch 跑一个单卡脚本，确认设备与混合精度。
再开多卡/FSDP，记录吞吐与显存，对比单卡基线。
firstRunEn: pip install accelerate, then run accelerate config to generate a default setup.
Launch a single-GPU script with accelerate launch to verify device and AMP.
Then enable multi-GPU/FSDP and record throughput and VRAM against the single-GPU baseline.
repos.deps: Python + PyTorch；多卡需要 NCCL 与同机/多机网络；DeepSpeed/FSDP 需要额外依赖与显存预算。
repos.depsEn: Python + PyTorch; multi-GPU needs NCCL and intra-/inter-node networking; DeepSpeed/FSDP add dependencies and VRAM budget.
repos.licenseNote: Apache-2.0；随附的 DeepSpeed、Transformer Engine 等组件各自许可，商用前核对。
repos.licenseNoteEn: Apache-2.0; bundled or optional DeepSpeed, Transformer Engine and other components carry their own licences.

repos.name: Datasets
repos.summary: Hugging Face 的数据集库：load_dataset 读取 Hub、Parquet、JSON、CSV，支持流式读取、内存映射、map/filter/shuffle 与 train/test split，不用先把整份语料塞进内存。
repos.summaryEn: Hugging Face’s dataset library: load_dataset reads Hub, Parquet, JSON and CSV with streaming, memory mapping, map/filter/shuffle and train/test splits — without loading the whole corpus into RAM.
why: 一行读取 Hub 数据集，版本与 schema 有记录。
流式与内存映射让大语料在笔记本上也能处理。
和 Transformers、Accelerate、PEFT 的训练循环直接衔接。
whyEn: One line loads a Hub dataset with a recorded version and schema.
Streaming and memory mapping make large corpora workable on a laptop.
Plugs directly into Transformers, Accelerate and PEFT training loops.
notFor: 不是数据治理平台；许可、PII 与去重仍要自己审。
超大语料需要流式或分片，随机访问会变慢。
复杂标注工作流应接 Argilla / Label Studio。
notForEn: Not a data-governance platform; licence, PII and deduplication remain your responsibility.
Very large corpora need streaming or sharding; random access gets slower.
Complex annotation workflows belong in Argilla or Label Studio.
firstRun: pip install datasets，先 load_dataset 一个小型文本数据集。
检查字段、split 与许可证，再做 map/filter 和 tokenizer。
大语料改用 streaming=True，测一遍吞吐与磁盘占用。
firstRunEn: pip install datasets and load a small text dataset first.
Inspect fields, splits and licence, then map/filter and tokenize.
For large corpora use streaming=True and measure throughput and disk use.
repos.deps: Python；Hub 访问需要网络；Parquet/Arrow 依赖内置；大规模处理需要磁盘与内存预算。
repos.depsEn: Python; network for Hub access; Parquet/Arrow support is built in; large jobs need disk and RAM budget.
repos.licenseNote: 代码 Apache-2.0；每个数据集有自己的许可与使用条款，商用前读 dataset card。
repos.licenseNoteEn: Code is Apache-2.0; every dataset has its own licence and terms — read the dataset card before commercial use.

repos.name: Ray
repos.summary: 分布式计算框架：把 Python 任务与 actor 扩展到多核多机；Ray Train / Serve / Data / Tune 覆盖训练、推理、数据加载与超参搜索。
repos.summaryEn: A distributed compute framework: scale Python tasks and actors across cores and machines; Ray Train / Serve / Data / Tune cover training, serving, data loading and hyperparameter search.
why: 同一套 API 从笔记本扩到集群，不用先上 K8s。
Ray Serve 能把多个模型/后端组成推理图。
Ray Tune 适合并行扫参，和训练框架解耦。
whyEn: The same API scales from a laptop to a cluster without starting with Kubernetes.
Ray Serve composes multiple models and backends into an inference graph.
Ray Tune parallelizes sweeps and stays framework-agnostic.
notFor: 不是 Kubernetes 替代；集群运维、网络与存储仍要自己做。
小任务调度开销可能大于收益，单机先跑通。
不是模型服务框架的全部；GPU 调度要单独规划。
notForEn: Not a Kubernetes replacement; cluster ops, networking and storage are still yours.
Scheduling overhead can outweigh gains on tiny jobs — prove it on one machine first.
Not a complete model-serving stack; GPU scheduling needs separate design.
firstRun: pip install ray，先用 ray.init() 跑一个远程 task。
再用 Ray Data 读一批文件，确认分片与吞吐。
需要服务时试 Ray Serve，给一个模型包 deployment。
firstRunEn: pip install ray and run a remote task with ray.init().
Then read a batch of files with Ray Data to check sharding and throughput.
For serving, try Ray Serve and wrap one model as a deployment.
repos.deps: Python；多机需要网络与集群启动配置；GPU 任务需要 CUDA 驱动与显存调度；生产建议配对象存储与监控。
repos.depsEn: Python; multi-node needs networking and cluster launch config; GPU jobs need CUDA drivers and VRAM scheduling; production wants object storage and monitoring.
repos.licenseNote: Apache-2.0；部分生态组件（如 Ray Serve 依赖）各自许可，商用前核对。
repos.licenseNoteEn: Apache-2.0; some ecosystem components and Ray Serve dependencies carry their own licences.

repos.name: MLflow
repos.summary: 实验跟踪、模型注册、打包与部署的开源平台：记录参数、指标与产物，比较 run，注册模型版本并部署 REST/gRPC 服务。
repos.summaryEn: An open-source platform for experiment tracking, model registry, packaging and deployment: log params, metrics and artifacts, compare runs, register model versions and serve over REST/gRPC.
why: 把“哪次实验、什么参数、什么指标”固定成可查询记录。
模型注册表能管版本与阶段，适合交接。
自托管、和主流训练框架都能接。
whyEn: Turns “which run, which params, which metrics” into a queryable record.
The model registry manages versions and stages, which helps handoffs.
Self-hostable and connects to mainstream training frameworks.
notFor: 不是专门的 LLM 可观测平台；prompt/trace 要接 Langfuse 或 Phoenix。
自托管要数据库与对象存储，规模大了要运维。
不是数据标注或向量库。
notForEn: Not an LLM-specific observability platform; prompt/trace needs Langfuse or Phoenix.
Self-hosting needs a database and object store; scale brings ops work.
Not an annotation tool or vector database.
firstRun: pip install mlflow，起本地 tracking server 或直接用文件后端。
在一个训练脚本里 log params、metrics 与模型产物。
再注册模型版本，试一次本地 REST 部署。
firstRunEn: pip install mlflow and start a local tracking server or use a file backend.
Log params, metrics and model artifacts from one training script.
Register a model version, then try a local REST deployment.
repos.deps: Python；本地文件后端可零依赖起步；生产要 Postgres/MySQL 与 S3/OSS 对象存储，部署还要容器或 VM。
repos.depsEn: Python; a local file backend needs no services; production wants Postgres/MySQL and S3-compatible storage, plus containers or VMs for serving.
repos.licenseNote: Apache-2.0；集成的数据库、对象存储与云服务各自条款。
repos.licenseNoteEn: Apache-2.0; integrated databases, object stores and cloud services have their own terms.

repos.name: Crawl4AI
repos.summary: 面向 LLM 的网页抓取与清洗：异步爬取、浏览器渲染、去噪、Markdown/JSON 输出、分块与缓存，适合把网页变成 RAG 可用的语料。
repos.summaryEn: LLM-oriented web crawling and cleaning: async crawling, browser rendering, boilerplate removal, Markdown/JSON output, chunking and caching — turning pages into RAG-ready corpus.
why: 输出直接是 Markdown/JSON，少写一套清洗管线。
异步与浏览器渲染能处理大量动态页面。
缓存、分块和结构化字段适合接向量库。
whyEn: Outputs Markdown/JSON directly, removing a separate cleaning pipeline.
Async crawling and browser rendering handle many dynamic pages.
Caching, chunking and structured fields plug into vector stores.
notFor: 不绕过付费墙、登录或 robots 限制；合规责任在使用者。
大规模抓取要代理、限速与反封策略，成本不低。
不是搜索引擎，也不做网页排名。
notForEn: Does not bypass paywalls, logins or robots restrictions; compliance is the operator’s job.
Large crawls need proxies, rate limits and blocking strategy — not free.
Not a search engine and does not rank pages.
firstRun: pip install crawl4ai，跑一次单页抓取，确认浏览器依赖已装。
开 Markdown 与去噪，检查表格/代码块是否保留。
再接分块与向量库，先小批量测重复率与失败率。
firstRunEn: pip install crawl4ai, crawl one page and confirm browser dependencies are installed.
Enable Markdown and boilerplate removal; check tables and code blocks survive.
Then add chunking and a vector store; measure duplication and failure rate on a small batch.
repos.deps: Python + Playwright/Chromium；网络出口与代理；大规模要队列、缓存与对象存储。
repos.depsEn: Python + Playwright/Chromium; outbound network and proxies; large jobs need queues, cache and object storage.
repos.licenseNote: Apache-2.0；抓取内容仍受原站版权、robots 与数据库权利约束。
repos.licenseNoteEn: Apache-2.0; crawled content remains subject to source copyright, robots and database rights.

repos.name: FastMCP
repos.summary: 用 Python 快速搭 MCP 服务器：装饰器声明 tools、resources 与 prompts，自动生成 schema，支持 stdio/HTTP、认证、组合与测试。
repos.summaryEn: Build MCP servers quickly in Python: decorators declare tools, resources and prompts, schemas are generated, with stdio/HTTP transports, auth, composition and testing.
why: 把函数变成 MCP tool 只需一个装饰器。
stdio 与 HTTP 两种传输都覆盖，客户端接入简单。
测试与组合能力比手写 JSON-RPC 省事。
whyEn: One decorator turns a function into an MCP tool.
Both stdio and HTTP transports are covered, simplifying client integration.
Testing and composition beat hand-written JSON-RPC.
notFor: 不是 MCP 客户端；仍要 Claude、Cursor 或其他 host 来连。
生产要自己加鉴权、限流、审计与网络隔离。
工具描述写不好，模型仍然不会正确调用。
notForEn: Not an MCP client; you still need Claude, Cursor or another host.
Production needs your own auth, rate limits, audit and network isolation.
Poor tool descriptions still cause bad model calls.
firstRun: pip install fastmcp，写一个 add(a,b) tool 并用内存客户端测。
再起 HTTP 传输，确认 host 能列出 tools 与调用。
加日志、超时与错误返回，再考虑鉴权。
firstRunEn: pip install fastmcp, write an add(a, b) tool and test it with the in-memory client.
Then start HTTP transport and confirm a host can list and call the tool.
Add logging, timeouts and error returns before thinking about auth.
repos.deps: Python 3.10+；stdio 无需网络，HTTP 部署要 ASGI 服务器与反向代理；生产要身份与审计。
repos.depsEn: Python 3.10+; stdio needs no network, HTTP needs an ASGI server and reverse proxy; production needs identity and audit.
repos.licenseNote: Apache-2.0；MCP 规范与客户端各自条款，商用前核对。
repos.licenseNoteEn: Apache-2.0; the MCP specification and clients carry their own terms.

repos.name: Instructor
repos.summary: 用 Pydantic 模型约束 LLM 输出：自动重试、流式部分对象、函数调用/JSON schema、多 provider 适配，让“返回一个结构体”变可靠。
repos.summaryEn: Constrain LLM output with Pydantic models: automatic retries, streaming partial objects, function calling / JSON schema and multi-provider adapters make “return a struct” reliable.
why: 把 schema、校验与重试放在一处，少写解析代码。
流式部分对象适合长表单与实时 UI。
支持多家 provider，换模型不必重写 schema 层。
whyEn: Schema, validation and retries live in one place, cutting parser code.
Streaming partial objects suit long forms and live UI.
Multi-provider support means changing models does not require rewriting the schema layer.
notFor: 不是 agent 框架；多步工具编排仍要 LangGraph 等。
模型不支持结构化输出时要降级，重试也有成本。
不负责 prompt 版本管理与评测。
notForEn: Not an agent framework; multi-step tool orchestration still needs LangGraph and similar.
Fallback is needed when a model lacks structured output, and retries cost tokens.
No prompt versioning or evaluation.
firstRun: pip install instructor，用 Pydantic 定义一个小 schema。
让模型返回该对象，故意给一个坏例子看重试。
再接流式与多 provider，记录失败率与 token 成本。
firstRunEn: pip install instructor and define a small Pydantic schema.
Ask the model for that object, then feed a bad example to see retries.
Add streaming and a second provider; record failure rate and token cost.
repos.deps: Python；至少一个模型 provider 的 API key 或本地 OpenAI 兼容端点；生产要重试预算与日志。
repos.depsEn: Python; an API key for at least one provider or a local OpenAI-compatible endpoint; production needs retry budgets and logs.
repos.licenseNote: MIT；接入的模型 provider 与 SDK 各自条款。
repos.licenseNoteEn: MIT; connected model providers and SDKs have their own terms.

repos.name: Outlines
repos.summary: 结构化生成库：用正则、JSON schema 或 CFG 约束 token 采样，保证输出可解析；支持 Transformers、vLLM、llama.cpp 等后端。
repos.summaryEn: Structured generation: constrain token sampling with regex, JSON schema or a CFG so output is parseable; supports Transformers, vLLM, llama.cpp and other backends.
why: 在采样层保证格式，不靠事后解析和重试。
本地模型也能得到稳定 JSON/枚举/正则输出。
和 vLLM、llama.cpp 等后端配合，适合抽取与表单。
whyEn: Guarantees format at the sampling layer instead of post-hoc parsing and retries.
Local models can produce stable JSON, enums and regex-constrained output.
Works with vLLM, llama.cpp and other backends for extraction and forms.
notFor: 约束会改变输出分布，可能降低多样性。
不是 agent 框架；工具编排与记忆仍要另接。
复杂 CFG 编写与调试有学习成本。
notForEn: Constraints change the output distribution and may reduce diversity.
Not an agent framework; tool orchestration and memory need separate pieces.
Complex CFGs have a learning and debugging cost.
firstRun: pip install outlines，先加载一个本地小模型。
用 JSON schema 约束生成一个对象，检查非法 token 是否被屏蔽。
换 vLLM 后端压测吞吐，比较无约束基线。
firstRunEn: pip install outlines and load a small local model.
Generate an object under a JSON schema and confirm invalid tokens are masked.
Switch to the vLLM backend, benchmark throughput and compare with an unconstrained baseline.
repos.deps: Python + PyTorch 或 vLLM/llama.cpp 后端；本地模型权重与显存；CFG 场景需要语法文件。
repos.depsEn: Python with PyTorch or a vLLM/llama.cpp backend; local weights and VRAM; CFG use needs grammar files.
repos.licenseNote: Apache-2.0；模型权重与后端各自许可。
repos.licenseNoteEn: Apache-2.0; model weights and backends carry their own licences.

repos.name: Argilla
repos.summary: 人机协同的数据标注与 curation 平台：数据集、标注任务、弱监督、模型反馈与 Hugging Face Hub 集成，适合 SFT/RLHF 数据。
repos.summaryEn: Human-in-the-loop data annotation and curation: datasets, labeling tasks, weak supervision, model feedback and Hugging Face Hub integration for SFT/RLHF data.
why: 把模型预标注、人工复核和数据集版本放在一条流里。
和 Hub 集成，标注完可直接进训练管线。
适合小团队做领域数据，不必自建标注后台。
whyEn: Model pre-labeling, human review and dataset versions live in one flow.
Hub integration lets annotated data go straight into training.
Suits small teams building domain data without a custom annotation backend.
notFor: 不是标注外包服务；标注指南与质控仍要自己定。
极小项目用 CSV/表格更快。
复杂权限、审计与 SLA 要评估企业方案。
notForEn: Not an outsourcing service; guidelines and quality control remain yours.
Tiny projects are faster with CSV or a spreadsheet.
Complex permissions, audit and SLAs need an enterprise evaluation.
firstRun: 用 Docker 起 Argilla，建一个 workspace 与 dataset。
导入几十条未标注样本，设一个分类或排序任务。
接模型预标注，人工改完后导出为训练格式。
firstRunEn: Start Argilla with Docker and create a workspace and dataset.
Import a few dozen unlabeled samples and define a classification or ranking task.
Add model pre-labeling, correct by hand and export a training format.
repos.deps: Docker / Python；生产要 Postgres 与对象存储；模型预标注要一个推理端点。
repos.depsEn: Docker / Python; production wants Postgres and object storage; model pre-labeling needs an inference endpoint.
repos.licenseNote: Apache-2.0；集成的模型与数据各自条款。
repos.licenseNoteEn: Apache-2.0; integrated models and data have their own terms.

repos.name: Label Studio
repos.summary: 多模态数据标注平台：文本、图像、音频、视频、HTML 与时间序列都能用模板化界面标注；支持 ML 后端预标注、多人协作与多种导出格式。
repos.summaryEn: A multimodal data-labeling platform: text, image, audio, video, HTML and time series with templated interfaces; ML-backend pre-labeling, multi-user collaboration and many export formats.
why: 一个界面覆盖多数模态，省去多套标注工具。
ML 后端可以把模型预测变成预标注。
导出格式多，接训练管线直接。
whyEn: One interface covers most modalities, avoiding several annotation tools.
An ML backend turns model predictions into pre-labels.
Many export formats plug straight into training pipelines.
notFor: 开源版与企业版功能不同，商用前读条款。
复杂权限、审计、SSO 与 SLA 通常要企业版。
不是数据治理或隐私合规平台。
notForEn: Community and enterprise editions differ — read the terms before commercial use.
Complex permissions, audit, SSO and SLAs usually require enterprise.
Not a data-governance or privacy-compliance platform.
firstRun: 用 Docker 起 Label Studio，建一个项目并选标注模板。
导入十几条样本，配一个 ML backend 做预标注。
导出 JSON/CoNLL，检查字段是否与训练代码对齐。
firstRunEn: Start Label Studio with Docker, create a project and pick a labeling template.
Import a dozen samples and connect an ML backend for pre-labeling.
Export JSON/CoNLL and check fields match the training code.
repos.deps: Docker / Python；生产要 Postgres 与对象存储；ML backend 要一个模型服务。
repos.depsEn: Docker / Python; production wants Postgres and object storage; ML backend needs a model service.
repos.licenseNote: 开源版 Apache-2.0；企业功能与托管服务另有商业条款，商用前核对。
repos.licenseNoteEn: Community edition is Apache-2.0; enterprise features and hosted service have commercial terms.

repos.name: LangChain
repos.summary: LLM 应用框架：模型、工具、检索、记忆与 agent 的组件化抽象；LangGraph 做有状态编排，LangSmith 做观测。
repos.summaryEn: An LLM application framework: component abstractions for models, tools, retrieval, memory and agents; LangGraph handles stateful orchestration and LangSmith observability.
why: 生态最大，几乎所有模型/向量库/工具都有适配。
从简单链到 agent 都有现成组件，起步快。
和 LangGraph、LangSmith 组成完整开发栈。
whyEn: The largest ecosystem, with adapters for most models, vector stores and tools.
Components for everything from simple chains to agents make starting fast.
Forms a full stack with LangGraph and LangSmith.
notFor: 抽象层多，简单调用可能被过度封装。
版本迭代快，生产要锁版本并读迁移说明。
不是推理引擎或托管平台。
notForEn: Many abstraction layers can over-wrap a simple call.
Fast-moving versions require pinning and reading migration notes.
Not an inference engine or hosting platform.
firstRun: pip install langchain，用统一模型接口跑一次调用。
加一个检索器与工具，做最小 chain。
需要状态/分支时再上 LangGraph，不要一开始就堆组件。
firstRunEn: pip install langchain and make one call through the unified model interface.
Add a retriever and a tool to build a minimal chain.
Move to LangGraph only when state or branching is needed; do not stack components on day one.
repos.deps: Python；模型 provider 的 API key 或本地端点；向量库与工具各有依赖。
repos.depsEn: Python; a provider API key or local endpoint; vector stores and tools bring their own dependencies.
repos.licenseNote: MIT；集成的模型、向量库与工具各自许可。
repos.licenseNoteEn: MIT; integrated models, vector stores and tools carry their own licences.

repos.name: LiveKit Agents
repos.summary: 实时语音/视频 Agent 框架：WebRTC 传输、语音活动检测、打断、工具调用与多模态管线放在一套运行时里。
why: 端到端实时链路是它的主场：WebRTC 传输、VAD、打断与轮次控制都有现成实现。
Python 框架可接多家 STT/TTS/LLM，适合做电话客服、实时助手与语音 Agent。
与 LiveKit Cloud / 自托管 SFU 配套，房间、参与者与录制权限可分开管。
notFor: 只做离线转写或批量音频处理，不需要实时房间与 WebRTC。
希望零代码搭语音机器人，先看平台型产品；这套要写管线与部署。
firstRun: 读官方 README / quickstart，确认 Python / LiveKit 版本与系统依赖。
按官方最小示例跑通 语音 Agent 最小房间，记录端口、密钥与数据路径。
换成自己的 1–2 个样本，观察延迟、并发与失败模式；不要先用生产流量压。
firstRunEn: Read the official README and quickstart; confirm the runtime version and system dependencies.
Run the smallest voice-agent room example and record ports, keys and data paths.
Try one or two of your own cases and watch latency, concurrency and failure modes; do not start with production traffic.
repos.deps: Python 运行时 + LiveKit server（Cloud 或自托管）+ STT/TTS/LLM 凭据；生产要 TURN、并发与录制存储。
repos.licenseNote: 代码 Apache-2.0；LiveKit Cloud、模型与语音供应商另计条款，商用前核对。
repos.summaryEn: A realtime voice/video agent framework: WebRTC transport, VAD, interruption, tool calls and multimodal pipelines in one runtime.
whyEn: Built for the realtime path: WebRTC transport, VAD, interruption and turn control are already implemented.
The Python framework connects to multiple STT/TTS/LLM vendors, suited to phone agents, live assistants and voice agents.
Pairs with LiveKit Cloud or a self-hosted SFU, with rooms, participants and recording permissions managed separately.
notForEn: Offline transcription or batch audio does not need realtime rooms and WebRTC.
For a no-code voice bot, start with a platform product; this expects pipeline and deployment work.

repos.name: Pipecat
repos.summary: 面向语音与多模态应用的实时管线框架：把 transport、VAD、STT、LLM、TTS 与打断串成可观测的帧流。
why: 帧流模型清楚：每个处理器的输入输出可观测，延迟卡在哪一段容易定位。
传输层可换（WebRTC、WebSocket、电话等），不把业务绑死在一个云。
Daily 维护、社区活跃，示例覆盖语音助手、实时视频与多模态。
notFor: 只做文本聊天，不需要音频帧与实时打断。
想要托管好的成品客服系统，先看 SaaS；这套要自己接供应商与部署。
firstRun: 读官方 README / quickstart，确认 Python 版本与系统依赖。
按官方最小示例跑通 本地语音管线，记录端口、密钥与数据路径。
换成自己的 1–2 个样本，观察延迟、并发与失败模式；不要先用生产流量压。
firstRunEn: Read the official README and quickstart; confirm the runtime version and system dependencies.
Run the smallest local voice pipeline example and record ports, keys and data paths.
Try one or two of your own cases and watch latency, concurrency and failure modes; do not start with production traffic.
repos.deps: Python 运行时 + 至少一家 STT/TTS/LLM 凭据；实时场景要 TURN / WebRTC 与稳定网络。
repos.licenseNote: 代码 BSD-2-Clause；Daily 托管、模型与语音供应商另计条款。
repos.summaryEn: A realtime pipeline framework for voice and multimodal apps: transport, VAD, STT, LLM, TTS and interruption as an observable frame stream.
whyEn: The frame-stream model is clear: each processor’s input and output are observable, so latency is easy to localise.
The transport layer is swappable (WebRTC, WebSocket, telephony), so the business is not locked to one cloud.
Maintained by Daily with an active community; examples cover voice assistants, realtime video and multimodal.
notForEn: Text-only chat does not need audio frames or realtime interruption.
For a hosted turnkey contact-centre product, look at SaaS; this expects vendor wiring and deployment.

repos.name: CVAT
repos.summary: 图像、视频、音频与 3D 数据的标注平台：框、多边形、关键点、轨迹、审核与团队协作都在一套 Web 应用里。
why: 视频与 3D 标注是强项：轨迹插值、多视图、审核与质量控制比通用工具细。
可自托管，数据不出内网；也有云与企业版，权限、分析与 API 分层。
AI 辅助标注与自动预标注可接模型，减少重复框选。
notFor: 只标几十张图、没有团队协作与审核需求，Label Studio 更轻。
需要文本/对话标注为主，先看 Argilla / Doccano 类工具。
firstRun: 读官方 README / quickstart，确认 Docker / Python 版本与系统依赖。
按官方最小示例跑通 CVAT 本地部署与一次标注任务，记录端口、密钥与数据路径。
换成自己的 1–2 个样本，观察延迟、并发与失败模式；不要先用生产流量压。
firstRunEn: Read the official README and quickstart; confirm the runtime version and system dependencies.
Run the smallest local CVAT deployment and one annotation job example and record ports, keys and data paths.
Try one or two of your own cases and watch latency, concurrency and failure modes; do not start with production traffic.
repos.deps: Docker / Docker Compose；生产要对象存储、数据库、鉴权与备份。
repos.licenseNote: 代码 MIT；云服务、企业功能与标注服务另计条款。
repos.summaryEn: An annotation platform for image, video, audio and 3D data: boxes, polygons, keypoints, tracks, review and team collaboration in one web app.
whyEn: Video and 3D annotation are the strengths: track interpolation, multi-view, review and QC are finer than generic tools.
Self-hostable, so data stays inside the network; cloud and enterprise tiers separate permissions, analytics and APIs.
AI-assisted and pre-annotation can call a model and reduce repeated box drawing.
notForEn: A few dozen images with no team review: Label Studio is lighter.
Text/conversation annotation should start with Argilla or Doccano-style tools.

repos.name: Steel Browser
repos.summary: 给 AI Agent 用的开源浏览器 API：会话、Cookie、代理、截图、PDF 与动作接口打包成可自托管的沙箱。
why: 把浏览器当服务：会话隔离、持久化登录态、代理与文件下载都有 API，不用自己拼 Playwright 基础设施。
可自托管，适合需要把浏览数据留在自己网络里的 Agent 项目。
与 Browser Use / Stagehand 类框架可配合，负责“浏览器运行时”这一层。
notFor: 只做一次性抓取，Firecrawl / 静态 HTTP 更省。
需要成熟云浏览器与全球代理，先比较 Browserbase 等托管服务。
firstRun: 读官方 README / quickstart，确认 Node / Docker 版本与系统依赖。
按官方最小示例跑通 Steel 本地会话与截图，记录端口、密钥与数据路径。
换成自己的 1–2 个样本，观察延迟、并发与失败模式；不要先用生产流量压。
firstRunEn: Read the official README and quickstart; confirm the runtime version and system dependencies.
Run the smallest local Steel session and screenshot example and record ports, keys and data paths.
Try one or two of your own cases and watch latency, concurrency and failure modes; do not start with production traffic.
repos.deps: Docker 或 Node 运行时 + Chromium；生产要会话存储、代理与资源限额。
repos.licenseNote: 代码 Apache-2.0；Steel 云服务与代理另计条款。
repos.summaryEn: An open-source browser API for AI agents: sessions, cookies, proxies, screenshots, PDFs and actions packaged as a self-hostable sandbox.
whyEn: Browser as a service: session isolation, persistent login state, proxies and downloads via API, without assembling Playwright infrastructure.
Self-hostable, suited to agent projects that must keep browsing data inside their own network.
Works with Browser Use / Stagehand-style frameworks as the browser runtime layer.
notForEn: One-off scraping is cheaper with Firecrawl or plain HTTP.
For mature cloud browsers and global proxies, compare hosted services such as Browserbase first.
